problems: All three dossiers start earlier than Cliopatria (Flanders 862, Blois 832, Champagne 990 as Cliopatria): the colour agent should seed the earlier start years; the pre-990 keyframes are new and carry confidence 2 or 1.

Blois and Champagne were one holder in 1022-1036, 1063-1088 and 1125-1151 (personal union); Cliopatria draws Champagne inside the Blois shape then. The two ledgers carry mirror loss/gain events with each other as counterpart; the rendering agent must not draw Champagne twice. The 1142-1144 contest with Louis VII is recorded only in the Blois ledger.

Cliopatria anomalies corrected by adjust verdicts: Bruges and the coast missing from the Flanders shapes 1010-1259; a Nevers block inside the Flanders shape 1272-1304; Lille, Douai and Orchies kept after 1305; Antwerp and Mechelen absent after 1357; Chartres and Châteaudun removed from Blois in 1294 instead of 1286; Provins and Château-Thierry; the Blois seat missing from three late shapes.

Several corrections hold for part of a Cliopatria row's years and are superseded by a new keyframe (for example county-of-blois_1034 with _1037; county-of-flanders_1188 with _1191); the keyframe notes say so. The shape_id of a new keyframe never collides with an existing id.

Page budget: Flanders 10 pages (budget 9; the tenth, Crown lands of France, was added for 1185), Blois 10 (budget 9, one of which, Châteaudun, was thin), Champagne 3 new pages plus 4 reused from Blois (budget 5). Distinct pages opened in the run: 20.
